root_help.stdout:
usage: pipeline_cli.py [-h] [--project PROJECT] [--strict]
                       {init,new,use,switch,projects,list,paths,info,script,voice,timing,extract,semantic-map,map,brief,direct,motion,sfx,render,qa,effects,status,merge,enhance,doctor,cli-spec,studio,auto,loop,run-all,run} ...

Unified Whiteboard Motion Graphics Multi-Project Pipeline (AION CLI)

positional arguments:
  {init,new,use,switch,projects,list,paths,info,script,voice,timing,extract,semantic-map,map,brief,direct,motion,sfx,render,qa,effects,status,merge,enhance,doctor,cli-spec,studio,auto,loop,run-all,run}
    init (new)          Initialize a new isolated video project
    use (switch)        Switch active working project
    projects (list)     List all video projects
    paths (info)        Show exact input/output paths for project
    script              Split and validate section scripts from master_script
    voice               Generate Voiceover
    timing              Generate Timing & SRT
    extract             Topological Asset Extractor
    semantic-map (map)  Map storyboard assets to timing sentences
    brief               Generate/validate AION Creative Brief
    direct              Generate or validate AION scene_graph.json
    motion              Prepare exhibit cards / soft-bottom asset derivatives
    sfx                 Mix narration WAV with RMS-ducked studio SFX
    render              Render Master Video (720p default, or --resolution
                        1080p)
    qa                  Run PostRender QA + 10-frame Contact Sheet + Scene
                        Graph Audit
    effects             EffectCraft Motion Effects Studio
    status              Show pipeline status matrix
    merge               Merge rendered sections into master documentary
    enhance             Apply Micro-Retention GIF Overlays with Pure Voiceover
                        (Zero-BGM Policy)
    doctor              Check FFmpeg, CraftApp binaries, GPU, storage & Gemini
                        keys
    cli-spec            Print live CLI schema JSON and optionally generate
                        CLI_REFERENCE.md
    studio              AION Creative Studio V5 (ECGC compiler, capabilities &
                        visual QA)
    auto (loop, run-all, run)
                        Autonomous production loop across stages 1..12

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --project PROJECT     Specify project name (overrides active project)
  --strict              Exit non-zero if any stage fails or reports errors

help_extract.stdout:
usage: pipeline_cli.py extract [-h] [--section SECTION] [--all]
                               [--mode {grid,contour}] [--rows ROWS]
                               [--cols COLS] [--from-zip FROM_ZIP]
                               [--project PROJECT]

options:

  --section SECTION     Section number (e.g. 01, 02, 03)
  --all                 Extract all sections

  --cols COLS           Grid cols for grid mode (default: 5)

                        from a ZIP archive
  --project PROJECT     Project name (overrides active project)

help_render.stdout:
usage: pipeline_cli.py render [-h] [--section SECTION] [--all]
                              [--engine {python,effectcraft}]
                              [--pipeline {auto,aion,legacy}]
                              [--resolution {720p,1080p,full,half,third,quarter}]
                              [--run-id RUN_ID] [--no-gpu] [--no-rollback]
                              [--project PROJECT]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --section SECTION     Section number (e.g. 01, 02, 03)
  --all                 Render all sections
  --engine {python,effectcraft}
                        Render engine (default: effectcraft)
  --pipeline {auto,aion,legacy}
                        Pipeline mode (default: auto)
  --resolution {720p,1080p,full,half,third,quarter}
                        Output resolution (default: 720p; pass 1080p or full
                        for 1920x1080)
  --run-id RUN_ID       Isolated run ID (prevents overwriting previous runs)
  --no-gpu              Disable GPU rendering flag
  --no-rollback         Keep partial outputs on render failure
  --project PROJECT     Project name (overrides active project)

help_auto.stdout:
usage: pipeline_cli.py auto [-h] [--project PROJECT] [--start START]
                            [--end END] [--engine {python,effectcraft}]
                            [--pipeline {auto,aion,legacy}]
                            [--from-stage {script,voice,timing,extract,semantic-map,brief,direct,motion,sfx,render,qa,merge}]
                            [--to-stage {script,voice,timing,extract,semantic-map,brief,direct,motion,sfx,render,qa,merge}]
                            [--resume] [--run-id RUN_ID]
                            [--mode {grid,contour}]
                            [--resolution {720p,1080p,full,half,third,quarter}]
                            [--no-gpu] [--no-rollback] [--skip-voice]
                            [--skip-timing] [--skip-extract] [--skip-render]
                            [--skip-merge] [--force]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --project PROJECT     Project name (overrides active project)
  --start START         Starting section number (default: 1)
  --end END             Ending section number (default: auto-detect)
  --engine {python,effectcraft}
                        Render engine (default: effectcraft)
  --pipeline {auto,aion,legacy}
                        Pipeline architecture (default: auto)
  --from-stage {script,voice,timing,extract,semantic-map,brief,direct,motion,sfx,render,qa,merge}
                        Start execution at this stage
  --to-stage {script,voice,timing,extract,semantic-map,brief,direct,motion,sfx,render,qa,merge}
                        Stop execution after this stage
  --resume              Resume isolated run from last successful stage
  --run-id RUN_ID       Explicit isolated run ID
  --mode {grid,contour}
                        Extraction mode (default: grid)
  --resolution {720p,1080p,full,half,third,quarter}
                        Output resolution (default: 720p -> 1280x720; pass
                        1080p or full for 1920x1080)
  --no-gpu              Disable GPU rendering flag
  --no-rollback         Disable rollback on failure
  --skip-voice          Skip voice generation
  --skip-timing         Skip timing alignment
  --skip-extract        Skip extraction
  --skip-render         Skip rendering
  --skip-merge          Skip final merge
  --force               Force regeneration of all stages
